rows.name: Coresignal Jobs API
rows.reason: Coresignal Jobs API supports traceable CI/CD/security extraction from company postings. Requires engineering, matching and interpretation; postings may describe desired skills, migration plans or client work instead of current deployment.

rows.name: PredictLeads Technology Detections API
rows.reason: PredictLeads lookup and extended detections expose stack-claim evidence. Exact CI/CD/security coverage and target-account accuracy were not tested; evidence remains observational.

rows.name: Sumble API
rows.reason: Sumble's indexed docs describe technology enrichment and job evidence, but opened pages yielded pointers only. Endpoint schemas, evidence access and product coverage remain unverified; usability determines scope fit.

rows.name: BuiltWith
rows.reason: Domain API discovers website technologies; replacement remains unconfirmed. Frontend focus is not prohibited. Internal CI/CD and security coverage is unverified, not officially unsupported.

rows.name: Enlyft API
rows.reason: Technographic API/MCP lead has official search evidence but unreadable REST documentation. Verify technology records/evidence dates in sample responses; no usable technology endpoint would mean scope mismatch.

rows.name: TheirStack Company Technographics API
rows.reason: TheirStack provides job-derived company technology mentions, confidence and observation dates. Job requirements only imply use; nonhiring companies/unmentioned tools are blind spots. Validate exact CI/CD/security coverage with samples.

rows.name: BuiltWith
rows.reason: Its reviewed API remains website-centered; surfaced hiring signals do not establish enough internal CI/CD/security coverage to resolve the user's stated limitation.

rows.name: Buildbot
rows.reason: Build/test/release automation does not supply company-stack discovery data. Buildbot may itself be detected; delivering the requested technographic API requires a separate collector/data product. Functional mismatch.

rows.name: GitHub Actions REST API for public workflows and runs
rows.reason: GitHub Actions API corroborates CI/CD through correctly linked public repository workflows/runs. Public practice may differ from internal production; it cannot discover private repositories, all CI or complete security stacks.

rows.name: HG Insights API
rows.reason: A broader enterprise alternative with company enrichment and installation verification metadata. Request a target-account and CI/CD/security sample before purchase; product-level coverage, commercial terms, and historical API-version availability were not established.

rows.name: Wappalyzer
rows.reason: Website discovery API offers cached/live options; website detection isn't prohibited. Internal CI/CD/security coverage beyond BuiltWith unestablished; retain provisionally, not as a verified primary alternative.

rows.name: Wappalyzer
rows.reason: Its lookup API fingerprints public websites, reproducing the stated visibility gap without establishing a prospect's private CI/CD or internal security stack.

rows.name: PredictLeads Technology Detections and Extended Technology Detections API
rows.reason: PredictLeads provides domain technology detections with job/web/DNS/connection clues. These do not guarantee deployment or company-wide use; inspect sources and validate technologies relevant to the consultancy.

rows.name: HG Insights Technographics API
rows.reason: Product-level company installation records and verification dates extend discovery beyond public websites. Validate CI/CD/security catalog coverage and account accuracy before buying; reviewed overview postdates question cutoff.

rows.name: TheirStack Technographics API
rows.reason: TheirStack matches CI/CD/security research with dated job mentions and confidence signals. Hiring evidence may be stale or aspirational; current deployments and account coverage require sample validation.

rows.name: Buildbot
rows.reason: Buildbot runs configurable build, test and release workflows; it does not discover other companies' technology stacks or provide technographic prospect intelligence.
